visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: XOR Instead of Counting Occurrences
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Every element is compared with every other element to count its occurrences. Use a single XOR pass. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: The counting version takes n squared comparisons and prints every value that occurs once. XOR takes n steps, uses one variable, and relies on the guarantee that exactly one value is single.
